threat_actors.name: BlackMatter
threat_actors.description: Originally associated with the BlackMatter Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) operation, but variants are now used by other RaaS groups.

malware.name: Ryuk Infostealer
malware.description: An exfiltration tool capable of programmatic identification and automatic exfiltration of data.

malware.name: Conti Ransomware
malware.description: A ransomware group that a newer variant of Exmatter was observed being used with for exfiltration.

tools.name: Exmatter
tools.description: Custom exfiltration tool that iterates through folders, prioritizes recently modified files, and excludes directories within 'C:\ProgramData\'. It uses SFTP to exfiltrate data, with options for WebDav failover and a SOCKS5 proxy.

tools.name: PowerShell
tools.description: Used by Exmatter to overwrite the file and delete itself after exfiltration, employing anti-forensic techniques.

tools.name: ADFind
tools.description: Tool used for network and Active Directory administration that can be abused for reconnaissance.

tools.name: Advanced IP Scanner
tools.description: Tool used for network scanning that can be abused for reconnaissance.

tools.name: Windows Sysinternals suite
tools.description: Legitimately signed binaries that can be used for malicious activities like credential dumping (Procdump) and malware/ransomware deployment (PsExec).

tools.name: Themida
tools.description: Anti-reverse engineering software protection utility used to protect the Exmatter executable.

attack_patterns: Targeting specific file extensions (web/application source code, Remote Desktop shortcuts, CAD/GIS files)
Use of legitimate tools for reconnaissance

behaviors.text: data exfiltration is performed shortly before ransomware deployment.
the tool prioritizes recently modified files for exfiltration.
the tool accepts command-line arguments to hide its window.
uses webdav as a secondary exfiltration method.
